properties.name: loop_status's served description trimmed from 2039 to under the 1500-char budget skill_lint enforces. Behaviour and parameters unchanged; every clause that survived is load-bearing (the approver discriminator, only-assignment-is-attributed, scoped-clean, the refusal on an unknown id). NO DESIGN MEANING. Worth recording as a real constraint rather than a nuisance: a served tool description is a BUDGETED surface, so a change that explains itself well in a commit message still has to earn its space in the description an agent reads at call time — and skill_lint is what enforces that, caught in CI after three local gates had already passed.
